-- intro: {{Infobox/Magic |image= Black Blade Rhya.png  |title= Imitation Magic |kanji= 模倣魔法 |romaji= Mohō Mahō |english= Copy Magic (VIZ, Funimation)  |user= #Rhya }} {{Nihongo|Imitation Magic|模倣魔法|Mohō Mahō}} is a magic attribute that allows a user to copy another mage's spells.
-- Description:
